title: Very Long-Run Discount Rates (NBER WP 20133; QJE 2015)
key_point: 80-99yr leaseholds ~16% below freehold, 100-125yr ~10%, 125-150yr ~8%; discounts similar outside London; valuers' priors dispersed.

title: Game of Zones: The Economics of Conservation Areas
key_point: New conservation designations at the margin show no significant price capitalisation; amenity gains offset by alteration restrictions.

title: Leasehold enfranchisement valuation rates (consultation)
key_point: Published 7 Sep 2026, closes 21 Oct 2026; options: Sportelli 5%/4.75% or updated ~6.3%/6.05%; marriage value removed.

title: Leaseholders protected from unfair cladding costs as building safety reforms come into force
key_point: BSA protections from 28 Jun 2022 for 11m+/5+ storey buildings; no non-cladding costs under £325k London, £175k elsewhere.

title: Trading Standards tells agents to 'embrace' material information guidance
key_point: NTSELAT Parts A (price, tenure, council tax), B (physical, utilities, parking), C (safety, restrictions, flood, planning, accessibility, mining).

title: Material information: what to know and what happens next
key_point: RICS warns agents lack surveyor expertise on building-safety costs; material info no substitute for survey; portals need ~12 months.

title: Soaring service charges on leasehold flats hit capital values
key_point: London service charge £2,801/yr, +41.2% in 5 years; 37% of flats exceed 1% of value; lenders exclude such flats.

title: Rocketing leasehold service charges putting off buyers, says big estate agency
key_point: Average charge £2,300 in 2024; gym +£561, lift +£364, concierge +£892 a year; buyers and lenders increasingly cautious.

title: Extend now or wait? The short lease dilemma under leasehold reform
key_point: Lease length drives marketability and mortgageability; deferment rate 5% to 4% roughly doubles reversion on £250k 80-year flat.

title: RICS updates guidance on Japanese knotweed
key_point: RICS dropped 7m rule from March 2022; knotweed poses little risk to robust buildings; previously cut values up to 15%.

title: London new build schemes charge 20% premium
key_point: PCL new-build £1,701 vs resale £1,418 per sqft (20%); premium erodes on resale; new-build areas grew slower.

title: Londoners pay 20% premium for outdoor space
key_point: About 20% premium for gardens/terraces; Bayswater patio +16%, Kensington garden flat +36% vs comparable units.

title: EPC ratings having limited impact on house prices: Nationwide
key_point: A/B homes ~1.7% premium vs D; F/G ~3.5% discount; C and E negligible difference.

title: The danger of leaseholds in London
key_point: Leasehold near-universal for English flats yet rare globally; examples of inflated service charges, insurance mark-ups, costly enfranchisement.

title: Why aren't properties in this block selling?
key_point: London £350k flats unsold: cladding history despite EWS1, district heating, main road, commercial units, shared ownership, hidden service charges.

title: Buying a flat with a short lease and extending it
key_point: Sub-50-year Bloomsbury flat: £40k quote likely excludes marriage value; realistic £90k+; mortgages hard; reform delayed.

title: Underpinning
key_point: Underpinning common in London clay Victorian homes; insurers wary, ~£2,500 excess; get structural certificate and cause of movement.

title: Buying a house with past subsidence problems
key_point: Surveyor: warrantied underpinning not inherently risky, stigma is the issue; insurance transfer and excess affect lending; repeat South London claims.

title: Leasehold vs freehold
key_point: £700k London buyer: flats nearly always leasehold; worries about major works and consent fees; share of freehold gives control.

title: If you're debating whether to buy a flat in a Georgian house
key_point: Listed Georgian conversion: noise through timber floors, no double glazing allowed, odd layouts, costly restoration; purpose-built more liveable.

title: Homes in London are cracking as the clay they are built on shrinks
key_point: Record Q2 2026 subsidence claims ~£20k average; 1.8m UK homes highly susceptible by 2070; underpinning £20k-£100k+.

title: Domestic private rented properties required to meet EPC band C by October 2030
key_point: PRS must reach EPC C by 1 Oct 2030; new fabric metric; £10k cost cap; fines up to £30k.

title: Should you wait for cheaper lease extensions?
key_point: Extension ~£4-6k above 80 years vs ~£50k below; 8% of leases have 80-90 years; reform earliest 2027.

title: Q&A: selling a top-floor flat with no lift
key_point: Agent advises pricing a fourth-floor walk-up ~20% below equivalent first-floor flat; lower service charge, narrower buyer pool.

title: The economics of iceberg homes: Are mega-basements just a sunk cost?
key_point: Savills: basement adds 10-15% to £1.5-2m house; basement sqft worth less; RBKC caps basements at 50% of garden.

title: Ceiling heights must stack up for home hunters
key_point: Exceptional ceilings add ~15% value; 2.7m+ sought vs 2.4m norm; raised ground and first floors command premium.

title: Sky high
key_point: Double-height ceilings rare and premium in prime central London; no quantified premium given.

title: Which property type offers the best value for money for London homebuyers?
key_point: London £/sqft: flats ~£956, terraces ~£891, semis ~£985, detached ~£1,113; size figures look questionable.

title: Material information in property listings: Parts A, B and C
key_point: Lettings Parts A-C: council tax, rent, deposit; physical, utilities, broadband, parking; safety, restrictions, flood, planning, accessibility, mining.

title: Material Information in Property Listings (Sales) v1.0
key_point: Official NTSELAT sales guidance; fetch returned only landing page noting June 2026 sales-pack plan.

title: An assessment of the effects of conservation areas on value
key_point: Snippet: 23% raw premium, ~9% after controls, spillover 500-700m, ~4 points lower for at-risk areas.

title: Does energy efficiency matter to home-buyers? EPC ratings and transaction prices in England
key_point: Snippet: positive EPC-price per sqm link in ~400k sales; larger for flats and terraces. Repository blocked.

title: Only small premiums for homes with better EPCs, finds Nationwide
key_point: Snippet: A/B +1.6% vs D, F/G -1.4%; buy-to-let A/B premium ~12.2%.

title: Revealed: penthouse premiums around the world
key_point: Snippet: penthouses ~35% premium per sqft across five cities, ~43% in London. Page returned 404.

title: How does your garden grow: putting a price on outside space
key_point: Paywalled; teaser references garden-square premiums and private garden sales in prime London.

title: Balconies and roof terraces provide 12% value boost
key_point: Snippet: balcony/terrace +12% (Chelsea up to 25%); communal garden +11% (up to 20%).

title: Building Safety Act 2022 leaseholder protections: what to do
key_point: Snippet: non-cladding costs capped £15k London, £10k elsewhere. Fetch returned 403.

title: Leasehold and Freehold Reform: What Solicitors Need to Know in 2026
key_point: Snippet: marriage value abolition and 990-year extensions not yet in force pending prescribed rates. Fetch rate-limited.
